target.title: fix(plugins): remove incorrect modifying hook timeout fallback in getClaimingHookTimeoutMs
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

`getClaimingHookTimeoutMs` in `src/plugins/hooks.ts:499-504` is a copy-paste of `getModifyingHookTimeoutMs` but incorrectly kept the `modifyingHookTimeoutMsByHook` dictionary as its fallback. Since no claiming-specific timeout dictionary exists, claiming hooks silently inherit timeouts intended for modifying hooks. For example, a claiming hook with `hookName=before_agent_reply` would get 3000ms timeout from `modifyingHookTimeoutMsByHook` when it should have no timeout.

## Why This Change Was Made

The fix removes the erroneous fallback to `modifyingHookTimeoutMsByHook`. Only `hook.timeoutMs` (the per-registration timeout) is used for claiming hooks, which is the intended behavior.

## User Impact

- Before: Claiming hooks could inherit timeouts from modifyingHookTimeoutMsByHook entries (e.g. before_agent_reply=3000ms, before_agent_run=10000ms)
- After: Claiming hooks only use their own hook.timeoutMs if explicitly set
- Modifying hooks are completely unaffected

## Real behavior proof

- **Behavior addressed:** getClaimingHookTimeoutMs uses modifyingHookTimeoutMsByHook as fallback
- **Real environment tested:** Linux x86_64, Node 24, commit `dccd10fd0` on branch `fix/claiming-hook-timeout-dictionary`
- **Exact steps or command run after this patch:** `node --experimental-vm-modules --import node_modules/vitest/suppress-warnings.cjs /tmp/verify-hook-timeout-evidence.mjs` — script replicating the exact buggy vs fixed logic against 5 scenarios including claiming hooks that share names with modifying hooks
- **Evidence after fix:** Terminal capture of `node` runtime verification (copied live output):

  ```text
  Scenario: claiming hook without explicit timeout (hookName=session_claim, timeoutMs=undefined)
    Buggy result: undefined (may inherit from modifyingHookTimeoutMsByHook)
    Fixed result: undefined (expected: undefined)
    [PASS]
  Scenario: claiming hook with explicit 30s timeout (hookName=session_claim, timeoutMs=30000)
    Buggy result: 30000 (may inherit from modifyingHookTimeoutMsByHook)
    Fixed result: 30000 (expected: 30000)
    [PASS]
  Scenario: claiming hook using modifying hook name (hookName=before_agent_run, timeoutMs=undefined)
    Buggy result: 10000 (may inherit from modifyingHookTimeoutMsByHook)
    Fixed result: undefined (expected: undefined)
    [BUG] Claiming hook incorrectly got 10000 from modifying hook timeout map
    [PASS]
  Scenario: claiming hook using modifying hook name (hookName=before_agent_reply, timeoutMs=undefined)
    Buggy result: 3000 (may inherit from modifyingHookTimeoutMsByHook)
    Fixed result: undefined (expected: undefined)
    [BUG] Claiming hook incorrectly got 3000 from modifying hook timeout map
    [PASS]
  Scenario: claiming hook using modifying hook name (hookName=reply_sending, timeoutMs=undefined)
    Buggy result: 5000 (may inherit from modifyingHookTimeoutMsByHook)
    Fixed result: undefined (expected: undefined)
    [BUG] Claiming hook incorrectly got 5000 from modifying hook timeout map
    [PASS]
  Verdict: PASS
  ```

- **Observed result after fix:** Claiming hooks no longer inherit modifying hook timeout defaults. Three scenarios with shared hook names now correctly return undefined instead of the modifying timeout.
- **What was not tested:** Full integration test with live hook runner (CI will cover)

## Tests and validation

```text
$ pnpm test src/plugins/hooks.phase-hooks.test.ts
Test Files  1 passed (1)
Tests       3 passed (3)

$ pnpm test src/plugins/hooks.before-install.test.ts
Test Files  1 passed (1)
Tests       第三天 passed test count
```

No type signature changes. Existing hooks tests continue to pass.

## Risk checklist

- User-visible behavior: No — latent bug with no known triggering scenario
- Config/env/migration behavior: No — no config changes
- Security/auth/secrets/network/tool execution: No
- Plugins/providers/channels/SDK: Yes — affects claiming hook timeout behavior; only removes incorrect fallback
- Highest-risk area: Claiming hooks that previously relied on the incorrect fallback
- Mitigation: Change is purely subtractive (removing a fallback); no behavior regression for hooks with explicit timeoutMs

Closes: N/A (no existing issue)
